extracted.name: Creamy sprout, hazelnut & leek pasta
extracted.description: Use up your leftover Christmas brussels sprouts in this comforting pasta recipe. The dish is healthy and low in calories, making it ideal after those festive indulgences
ingredient_lines: 200g brussels sprouts ½ chopped and ½ quartered
350g short pasta (riciolli or fusilli work well)
1 tbsp grated parmesan or veggie alternative
½ small bunch of parsley finely chopped
instruction_lines: Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a low heat. Add the leeks and brussels sprouts and cook for 10-15 mins or until softened. Add the garlic and cook for 1 min. Stir through the hot stock and crème fraîche.

Cook the pasta following pack instructions. Drain and toss with the leeks and sprouts, parmesan, lemon, parsley and hazelnuts, adding a ladleful of the pasta cooking water if needed to loosen. Season to taste and spoon into four bowls.
